features: Full-Size Wired Keyboard with Num Pad – The Portronics Ki-Pad 4 is a full-size wired keyboard featuring 104 keys and a dedicated numeric pad, perfect for office, home, and study use.
Plug-and-Play USB Wired Keyboard – No drivers needed — simply plug this USB wired keyboard into your laptop or desktop and start typing instantly with smooth connectivity.
Multimedia Hotkey Support – Access music, videos, and volume controls quickly with 12 multimedia function keys built into the wired keyboard for better productivity.
Comfortable & Silent Typing – The soft-touch keys of this wired keyboard offer a smooth, quiet typing experience for long hours of work or gaming.
Durable 1.5 Metre Cable Design – The long wired connection ensures flexibility and clutter-free desk setup, making it ideal for professional and personal use.
Strong Build & Anti-Slip Base – This Portronics wired keyboard is built with a sturdy frame and anti-slip rubber pads to stay secure on any surface while you type.
Compatible with Windows & macOS – The Ki-Pad 4 USB wired keyboard works seamlessly with Windows 11/10/8/7 and macOS systems for universal use.
